evidence.text: Net cash flows from financing activities during the year ended December 31, 2012 decreased approximately $3,529,000 to $6,610,000 as compared to $10,139,000 during the year ended December 31, 2011. Cash flows from financing activities during the current year include approximately $6,001,000 received from the exercise of warrants, $1,052,000 received from the exercise of stock options, $427,000 in payments related to the acquisition of Surgical Biologics, and $16,000 in payments on an equipment lease.
